architecture-specification.high-level-model:
BlueTEXT uses a static-site architecture with generated data files for runtime features.
index.html

runtime-boot-sequence.step: app.js checks for inline pre-injected header/footer layouts, otherwise loads them asynchronously
app.js hoists modals (searchModal, authModal) to body for Bootstrap modal stability
app.js loads tools data and dispatches "bt:data-ready" event
Features modules like nav.js, auth.js, theme.js load and initialize

module.name: nav.js
module.feature: Translation engine mapping DOM elements to pre-compiled dictionaries at assets/data/i18n/[lang]-dictionary.json

module.name: auth.js
module.feature: Client-side session mock registration, sign-in, and sign-out persisted in localStorage

module.name: theme.js
module.feature: Light/dark mode theme toggler preserving user choices

data-generation-layer.capability: Normalize legal/nav HTML stubs into full layout-integrated policy pages
Generate sub-folder indexes mapping inner tools dynamically
Produce search-index.json containing title, description, and keywords metadata
Compile multi-language dictionaries using Google Translate API delimiter batching
GenerateTraditional Chinese catalog offline utilizing chinese-conv package
Compile search, translation, and index maps into static sitemap.xml file

accessibility-and-compliance.structure: Policy pages inside assets/nav, referenced cleanly from small footer panels
accessibility-and-compliance.aria: Landmark structures, keyboard navigability on controls, clear semantic heading tags
